components.name: Primary action
components.note: One clear action per active stage; keep an accessible name and a visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Secondary action
components.note: Keep supporting actions visually quieter than the current primary action.

components.name: Recording state
components.note: Show recording with text and a persistent visual signal; never rely on color alone.

components.name: Local execution
components.note: Name the on-device or local runtime so local processing is not mistaken for cloud work.

components.name: Inferred result
components.note: Mark generated or inferred content as pending review until the user confirms it.

components.name: Focus indicator
components.note: Use a visible focus outline independently from material, border or shadow styling.

components.name: Empty and unavailable
components.note: Explain the next available action and why an unavailable capability cannot run.

components.name: Error and recovery
components.note: State what happened, whether source data remains safe, and how to retry or recover.

surfaces.name: Desktop
surfaces.principle: Liquid Glass shell; reader surfaces retain readable tint, explicit focus and stable navigation.

surfaces.name: Mobile
surfaces.principle: Touch-first responsive layouts; landscape stays Mobile and primary targets remain at least 44 dp.

surfaces.name: Web dashboard
surfaces.principle: Reuse semantic colors and type; disclose authentication, local runtime and connection state.

surfaces.name: Landing
surfaces.principle: Use the same Quiet Archive identity and truthful capability language without implying unavailable product behavior.

surfaces.name: In-app companion
surfaces.principle: Remain inside the FUNG window and preserve focus, Escape and recording state boundaries.

accessibility: Listed solid-color pairs are measured by the generated contrast report.
The report is token-level evidence and does not certify the whole application.
Glass blur, image backgrounds, native overlays and real keyboard/screen-reader behavior need surface-level checks.
